description: Modoc County, CA – Today, Republican candidate Heather Hadwick announces an endorsement from former Placer County Supervisor Kirk Uhler. Kirk Uhler became the second youngest supervisor in California history when he was elected at 25 years old in 1992. Uhler served on the Placer County Board of Supervisors for 18 years until his retirement on January 4th, 2021.
